A LITTLE TRANSPARENCY

Your work stays yours.

Browser tools

Image processing and text transformations happen in your browser. Images are not uploaded. Text is only sent to cloud storage when you are signed in and explicitly save a draft.

Local workspace

Favorites, presets, saved drafts, timer settings and completed focus sessions are stored in this browser. Clearing browser storage removes local data. Use the workspace export to keep a backup.

Optional account

When configured, Google sign-in is provided through Supabase. Account identity and items you save are stored with Supabase, with access limited to your account. The application requests basic profile and email information, not access to your Google files.

Your controls

Delete individual saved items in Workspace, export your workspace, or sign out. Signing out hides account data on this device. The platform does not add advertising trackers.

External destinations

About Me, 3A3D, GitHub and Pixiv are independent websites with their own privacy policies.
